# EisnerAmper

> EisnerAmper is a leading professional services firm providing comprehensive assurance, tax, advisory, and outsourcing solutions for organizations across industries.

EisnerAmper specializes in audit and assurance services (including SOC reporting), regulatory compliance (SOX, CFIUS, AML), risk management, cyber security, AI consulting, and strategic advisory. The firm serves public, private, and governmental entities with deep expertise in financial reporting, internal controls, and digital transformation.

## Key Topics

- Assurance & Audit Services
- SOC 1, SOC 2, SOC 3 Reporting
- Risk Management & Compliance
- Regulatory Compliance (SOX, CFIUS, AML)
- Cyber Risk & Data Privacy
- AI Consulting & Strategy
- Internal Audit Services
- Advisory Services
- Data Analytics & Business Intelligence
- Change Management
- Compensation Consulting
- Project Management
- PCAOB & SEC Compliance
- Professional Services
- Digital Transformation
